events: Registered brand 'maurice'
First product – Heat Pillar launched
Electric Water Heaters from 1L to 25L introduced
Launched Inductions and small room heaters
Introduced Table, Wall, Pedestal and All-Purpose fans
Launched energy-efficient elements with maximum heat radiation
Launched Madhani Gas Stoves and Electric Chimneys for Indian homes
Introduced Carbon Rod Heat Pillars
Upgraded water heaters with smart ABS outer body
Expanded to heavy-duty 35L and 50L Water Heaters
Launched Irons – 2 models (Heavy Weight Iron and Steam Iron)
Commissioned manufacturing units in Bawana (Delhi) and Jia, Kullu (Himachal Pradesh)
Introduced Gas Room Heaters and Mixer Grinders – 2 models
Launched JMG, Hand Blenders and mini Choppers
Developed expanded variants and advanced designs for Room Heaters and Ceiling Fans
Achieved BIS (ISI) Certification across core manufacturing lines
Upgraded manufacturing procedures and advanced laboratory testing hubs
Scaled domestic production for Induction Cooktops
Secured HPBOCW rate contract – approved L1 Vendor
Supplied 45,000 units MIC-21 Induction Cooktops to Sericulture Offices across Himachal Pradesh
Maintained rate contract with Controller of Stores, Udhyog Bhawan, Shimla
Supplied 95,000 units Rado Heat Pillars (1-year warranty) to Government offices in Himachal Pradesh
Received order of 9,600 units Rado Heat Pillars from Himachal Pradesh Government
Introduced ABS Body Heat Blowers – 5 models (Economy Range)
Launched Single Rod Heat Pillars for small offices and compact rooms
Entered beverage appliance market with Electric Kettles – 1.5L and 1.8L variants
Introduced Sandwich Toasters
Launched automated Atta Chakki units for premium domestic use
Expanded air management range with Bathroom and Kitchen Exhaust Fans and Ventilating Fans

company.vision: To become one of India's most trusted and globally recognized home appliance brands by delivering innovative, energy-efficient, and high-quality products that improve everyday living while exceeding customer expectations.
missions: To design and manufacture world-class home appliances with uncompromising quality.
To continuously innovate through advanced technology and modern manufacturing practices.
To deliver exceptional value through performance, durability, and affordability.
To provide outstanding customer service and dependable after-sales support.
To strengthen our presence across domestic and international markets while building long-term customer trust.

coreValues.name: Innovation
coreValues.body: Continuously creating smarter, better solutions by combining evolving technologies with customer insights to improve everyday living.

coreValues.name: Quality
coreValues.body: The foundation of trust. Every Maurice product undergoes rigorous quality inspections to ensure safety, durability, efficiency, and consistent performance.

coreValues.name: Reliability
coreValues.body: Building lasting relationships with customers and business partners through strict performance criteria and dependable products.

coreValues.name: Affordability
coreValues.body: Delivering premium quality home and kitchen appliances at competitive price points, making quality accessible to every Indian family.

coreValues.name: Service Excellence
coreValues.body: A responsive service network focused on ownership convenience before, during, and after every purchase – building lifelong relationships.

coreValues.name: Integrity
coreValues.body: Conducting business with honesty, transparency, professionalism, and ethical standards in every interaction.

coreValues.name: Excellence
coreValues.body: Continuous pursuit of perfection in manufacturing, product development, service, and daily business operations.

coreValues.name: Energy Efficiency
coreValues.body: Designing products that save energy, reduce household expenditures, and promote ecological safety for a sustainable future.

coreValues.name: Global Ambition
coreValues.body: Expanding market footprints and proudly representing high-standard Indian manufacturing on the world stage.

philosophy.quote: Technology should simplify life rather than complicate it.
principles: Service Excellence that builds lifelong relationships
